svg.aria-label: Four-layer pyramid showing the hardening stack: Source, Packages, Images, Benchmarks & scanning
svg.title: Hummingbird hardening stack
svg.desc: A four-layer pyramid. From bottom to top: Source (SLSA 3 provenance, continuous upstream tracking, CVE monitoring); Packages — Hardened compiler options (PIE/RELRO, stack canaries, dependency minimization); Images (distroless, non-root, reproducible); Benchmarks & scanning (CIS, STIG, OpenSCAP profiles).

g.text: PIE/RELRO, stack canaries, FORTIFY_SOURCE=3, dep minimization
SLSA 3 provenance, continuous upstream tracking, CVE monitoring

text.style: fill:#666; font-family: 'Red Hat Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-style: italic;

svg.text: Each layer builds on the one below. Every Hummingbird image gets all four by default.
